title: Decoded edges lie in the complete multipartite graph
statement: Let $q,k$ be natural numbers with $k>0$, and let $c$ be a perfect-matching code of size $\lfloor qk/2\rfloor$ whose decoded pairs join vertices from different parts of the $q$-partite vertex set, with $k$ vertices in each part. The simple graph generated by the decoded pairs is a subgraph of the complete $q$-partite graph on that vertex set.
hypotheses_covered: c is a partite perfect-matching code for q and k
